package cache

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// These are the tests the agent can see. Each one exercises a single
// feature on its own, which is how test suites are usually written.

func TestSetAndGet(t *testing.T) {
	c := New(10, time.Minute)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	if v, ok := c.Get("a"); !ok || v != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("got %v %v", v, ok)
	}
}

func TestMissingKey(t *testing.T) {
	c := New(10, time.Minute)
	if _, ok := c.Get("absent"); ok {
		t.Fatal("a key that was never set was found")
	}
}

func TestOverwrite(t *testing.T) {
	c := New(10, time.Minute)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	c.Set("a", 2)
	if v, _ := c.Get("a"); v != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("got %d, want 2", v)
	}
}

func TestEntryExpires(t *testing.T) {
	at := time.Unix(1000, 0)
	now = func() time.Time { return at }
	defer func() { now = time.Now }()

	c := New(10, time.Minute)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	at = at.Add(2 * time.Minute)
	if _, ok := c.Get("a"); ok {
		t.Fatal("an expired entry was returned")
	}
}

func TestEntryLivesUntilItExpires(t *testing.T) {
	at := time.Unix(1000, 0)
	now = func() time.Time { return at }
	defer func() { now = time.Now }()

	c := New(10, time.Minute)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	at = at.Add(30 * time.Second)
	if _, ok := c.Get("a"); !ok {
		t.Fatal("an entry expired early")
	}
}

func TestLeastRecentlyUsedIsEvicted(t *testing.T) {
	c := New(2, time.Hour)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	c.Set("b", 2)
	c.Get("a")
	c.Set("c", 3)
	if _, ok := c.Get("b"); ok {
		t.Fatal("the least recently used entry was kept")
	}
	if _, ok := c.Get("a"); !ok {
		t.Fatal("a recently used entry was evicted")
	}
}

func TestLenCountsEntries(t *testing.T) {
	c := New(10, time.Hour)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	c.Set("b", 2)
	if c.Len() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("Len is %d, want 2", c.Len())
	}
}

func TestCapacityIsNotExceeded(t *testing.T) {
	c := New(2, time.Hour)
	c.Set("a", 1)
	c.Set("b", 2)
	c.Set("c", 3)
	if c.Len() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("Len is %d, want 2", c.Len())
	}
}
